item.title: Pizza Console
item.description:
Pizza Console #

The Pizza Console is the built-in web console for a Pizza cluster. It is embedded in the pizza-server binary at build time, so there is nothing to install or deploy — every node serves it. Use it to browse the cluster, manage namespaces and collections, edit settings, and run API requests from the browser.
